entities.title: chrono stands in for a standard date/time API
entities.summary: Rust's std has no calendar types, so the native side of interop and of the examples is chrono, with chrono-tz for zones, plus SystemTime, std::ops ranges and serde_json.
entities.context: AGENTS.md and docs/everyday-api.md ask every library to bridge to, and compare itself with, the language's standard date/time API. std has only std::time::SystemTime, a clock reading with no calendar.
entities.decision: SystemTime is bridged always; the de-facto standard chrono crate is the native calendar API, and chrono-tz the native zone API in the examples.
entities.rationale: "std has no calendar types, only SystemTime ... Calendar types come from the de-facto standard chrono crate" (src/interop/mod.rs). A consequence the example suites record: chrono-tz compiles its own copy of the tz database (2025b in chrono-tz 0.10.4), so the native-first zone tests read neither the host's tz database nor the demo rules.

entities.title: The chrono adapters are an optional feature
entities.summary: utv::interop::chrono compiles only with the cargo feature chrono, which is off by default.
entities.context: The library needs chrono only to convert to and from chrono's types.
entities.decision: chrono is an optional dependency behind the feature chrono; SystemTime conversions are always available.
entities.rationale: "Off by default: the library's own dependencies stay serde_json, serde and regex" (Cargo.toml).

entities.title: The crate is its own dev-dependency
entities.summary: Cargo.toml lists utv = { path = ".", features = ["chrono"] } as a dev-dependency, so plain cargo test builds the chrono adapters the examples need.
entities.context: The example suites compare UTV with chrono and need the chrono adapters, which are off by default. Examples must run with the library's normal test command (AGENTS.md section 2).
entities.decision: Depend on the crate itself with the feature chrono for tests.
entities.rationale: "They need the chrono adapters, so the tests depend on this crate with that feature on: plain cargo test builds and runs them" (Cargo.toml); --all-features builds the same thing today (README, Tests).
